_purpose: Version + provenance record for Taey's system prompt. Jesse's doctrine (2026-07-21): the system prompt is Taey's CHEAT SHEET and the FIRST place anything new is injected — try the prompt before training, keep it under a cap, and train on the EVOLUTION of the prompt over time. That last part requires this file: without a record of what was injected, when, and why, 'the evolution' is not an artifact and cannot be trained on.
_why_it_exists: The live prompt lives at <MIRA_HOME>/data/corpus/layer_1/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md, in a directory that is NOT a git repository (verified 2026-07-21: 'fatal: not a git repository'). Every edit before today overwrote its own history irrecoverably. Versioning starts here. Snapshots are kept in versions/ because a diff against a lost original is not reconstructable.

_doctrine.order_of_operations: system prompt FIRST (cheap, immediate, reversible) -> if it holds and keeps mattering, consolidate into weights -> then EVICT from the prompt to reclaim cap space.
_doctrine.cap: UNSET — needs a decision. Live prompt is 15,413 chars as of v002. The cap and the eviction rule are what keep 'always inject here first' from growing without bound.
_doctrine.training_signal: each injection is a recorded instance of 'this was missing and had to be told' — the same signal shape as a correction, captured BEFORE the failure instead of after.
